strings.name: Tarana Burke
strings.summary: Burke long worked with Black girls and survivors of sexual violence, launching Me Too in 2006 around empathy, resources and community support. When the phrase became a global hashtag in 2017, she emphasized survivors’ healing and agency beyond celebrity news. She co-founded me too. International and continues organizing, publishing and public speaking.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; reviewed on 15 November. This is not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Initiated Me Too against sexual violence; her survivor-support approach spread with the global social movement and influenced public discussion.
